problem_type: Model transport bypasses the application route
symptom: Electron lane request through a configured proxy never reaches the local HTTP fixture and returns Connection error.
direct_cause: Provider options did not supply appFetch; pi used global fetch instead.
class_root: The shared model assembly did not require a transport dependency, so all lane entry points could bypass application routing.
affected_population: Persistent lanes, single shots and all supported model protocols on configured proxies

external_sources.purpose: Installed pi 0.85.1 StreamOptions exposes fetch for every provider stream.

invariants: Every model request uses the explicitly supplied transport; desktop supplies appFetch.
generality_proof: Both stream and streamSimple options are assembled in createNomiProvider, spanning turns, summaries and single shots.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Require fetch and install it for every protocol and stream.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls the shared provider with the required options.fetch dependency.
Calls the shared provider with the required options.fetch dependency.

recurrence.reason: Both entry points and all protocols can miss the same configured route.
same_class_scan: rg createNomiProvider: laneHost, laneSingleShot and synthetic fixtures
rg appFetch: desktop assembly did not inject it; old runtime did.

prevention.invariant: Required fetch is passed by every caller and cannot be overridden by SDK defaults.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing transport is rejected by TypeScript; provider rejects a nonfunction at runtime.
prevention.strategy: One required dependency at the shared request assembler.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the implicit globalThis.fetch fallback from provider assembly.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The existing SDK already exposes the required fetch option; application injection was missing.
exit_criteria: Reassess on pi protocol changes; real Electron route suite must remain green.

migration: No persisted data changes. Desktop supplies appFetch and synthetic callers supply globalThis.fetch explicitly.
residual_risks: Real Electron three-protocol single/persistent matrix passed through a local CONNECT proxy; this does not certify remote provider availability.
